title: Stall-guard wk-exemption (howto)
desc: How the stall-guard exempts wk-tools and delegation launchers: the exempt set, the hyphen-allowing regex, and the shared Test-WkPaceExempt decision.
steps: HOW it works: the stall-guard fires when a ROOT session goes too long without a successful delegation, so it must EXEMPT commands that ARE delegation or wk-tool work -- the launcher/tool call itself must not be counted against the stall window.

EXEMPT SET: wk-prefixed tools (wkappbot, wkedit, wkcodex, wkagy, wkhippo, and repo-root ./wk-<name>.cmd launchers), git, gh, Agent.cmd, codex, and delegation launchers. The recognition regex MUST allow a hyphen after wk (wk then hyphen-or-word) so a hyphenated launcher like ./wk-cdp.cmd is recognized, matching the _WkRelWkPattern convention.

SHARED DECISION: the single source is Test-WkPaceExempt in wkharness-common-classify.ps1 (the one decision used by stall-guard plus wk-only-gate). The stall-guard, wk-only-gate, and pace verdict should ALL consult it rather than each inline-duplicating the exemption regex, which is how the hyphen drift happened.
author: claude
